era.requiredEvidence: Explicit date or reliably identified subject era relevant to the knowledge being asked; record role separately.

assignmentRules.uncertainAssignments: Keep as proposals in audit, not silently publish as definite tags.
assignmentRules.locationMentionScope: Prompt and all answer options, including distractors; retain surface name, role, region and uncertainty separately.
assignmentRules.eraAnswerScope: Tag the canonical answer era, not every date distractor; preserve date role.
assignmentRules.fictionalLocations: Record fictional or ambiguous locations as proposals unless a real-world referent is explicit; titles may contain place mentions without audience implications.
assignmentRules.historicalFigureBoundary: Political/religious leaders, philosophers and explorers treated as historical subjects; celebrity/author status alone is insufficient. Ambiguous cases remain proposals.

deprecatedValues.subject:film-characters: Use subject:screen-characters for film and television; v1 labels remain historical.

revisionNotes: Added people for explicitly personal biography/interview questions not testing the person's music or acting work.
Added radio where the source explicitly names radio broadcasting.
Added animation for explicitly anime/animated-media knowledge; avoids guessing television versus film.
Luna production remains frozen on vocabulary v2. These additions are only applied in separate content-reviewed contributions.
